name: Rose-breasted Grosbeak
facts: Call pattern: a rich, hurried warble, often described as a robin that has taken voice lessons.
Habitat: deciduous woods, forest edges and leafy parks. Both parents sing, and the male will sing while sitting on the eggs.
Migration: long-distance. Winters in Central and northern South America.
